goals.text: Count the words of a text file from the command line

terms.name: word
terms.definition: A run of characters without whitespace.

rules.trigger: the user runs the tool with a file path
rules.response: shall print the number of words in the file

examples:
Feature: Word count

  Rule: R-1

    @R-1 @E-1
    Scenario: Count the words of a file
      Given a file with the text "one two three"
      When the user runs wordcount with the file's path
      Then the tool prints 3
